# Auto-generated by scripts/alp_orchestrate.py -- do not edit.
# Per-core Kconfig fragment for slice `m55_he` (zephyr).

CONFIG_ALP_SDK=y
CONFIG_LOG=y
CONFIG_PRINTK=y
CONFIG_THREAD_LOCAL_STORAGE=y
CONFIG_LOG_DEFAULT_LEVEL=3

# Console: Alp UART console (auto-selected for os: zephyr).
# printf/LOG land on the module's console UART (the board layer
# owns the `zephyr,console` DT chosen + pinmux -- e.g. E1M edge
# UART0).  Override in board.yaml with `diagnostics.console: ram`
# (SWD bench flow) or `none` (inherit the board default).
CONFIG_SERIAL=y
CONFIG_CONSOLE=y
CONFIG_UART_CONSOLE=y
CONFIG_UART_INTERRUPT_DRIVEN=y

# Boot-banner SoC identity + system summary (from the SoC spec JSON + SoM preset `memory:`; see alp_banner.c).
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_SOC_NAME="Alif Ensemble E3"
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_SOC_CPUS="M55-HE @160MHz (active) + M55-HP @400MHz"
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_SOC_NPUS="2x Ethos-U55"
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_SOC_SRAM_KB=13824
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_SOC_MRAM_KB=5632
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_SOM_DRAM_MBIT=256

# On-module HW manifest EEPROM -> portable bus 0 (alp-i2c0);
# enables alp_hw_info_read() + the console banner manifest line.
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_HW_INFO_EEPROM_I2C_BUS_ID=0

CONFIG_ALP_SDK_SOM_HW_REV="2626-r2"

# SoM silicon (alif:ensemble:e3 via E1M-AEN301)
CONFIG_ALP_SOC_ALIF_ENSEMBLE_E3=y

# Cross-EVK board facade selector (<alp/board.h>); CONFIG_COMPILER_OPT is single-value (do not also set in prj.conf).
CONFIG_COMPILER_OPT="-DALP_BOARD_E1M_EVK"

# SoM-intrinsic chip drivers (from `E1M-AEN301` on_module + helper_firmware)
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_CHIP_CC3501E=y
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_CHIP_EEPROM_24C128=y
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_CHIP_OPTIGA_TRUST_M=y
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_CHIP_RV3028C7=y
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_CHIP_TMP112=y

# Board-populated chip drivers (from the resolved board definition)
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_CHIP_BME280=n
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_CHIP_BMI323=y
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_CHIP_BMP581=y
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_BLOCK_BUTTON_LED=y
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_CHIP_CAM_MUX_PI3WVR626=y
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_CHIP_ICM42670=y
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_CHIP_INA236=y
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_CHIP_LIS2DW12=n
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_CHIP_OV5640=n
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_BLOCK_PDM_MIC=y
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_CHIP_SSD1331=n
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_CHIP_TAS2563=y
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_CHIP_TCAL9538=y

# Zephyr subsystems required on core `m55_he` (chip drivers + peripherals)
CONFIG_GPIO=y
CONFIG_I2C=y
CONFIG_RTC=y
CONFIG_SENSOR=y
CONFIG_SERIAL=y
CONFIG_SPI=y

# Per-slice memory tuning (board.yaml cores.<id>.memory:)
CONFIG_MAIN_STACK_SIZE=4096
CONFIG_HEAP_MEM_POOL_SIZE=16384

# Per-slice power-management profile (board.yaml cores.<id>.power:)
CONFIG_PM=y
CONFIG_PM_DEVICE=y
# Sleep target: deep
# wakeup source: uart (DT wakeup-source; + pm_device_wakeup_enable() pending v0.7)
# wakeup source: gpio_int (DT wakeup-source; + pm_device_wakeup_enable() pending v0.7)
# wakeup source: rtc (DT wakeup-source; + pm_device_wakeup_enable() pending v0.7)

# Per-module log-level overrides (board.yaml diagnostics.modules:)
# CONFIG_ALP_GPIO_LOG_LEVEL_WRN=y (pending LOG_MODULE_REGISTER on this SDK module)
# CONFIG_ALP_I2C_LOG_LEVEL_WRN=y (pending LOG_MODULE_REGISTER on this SDK module)
